payload.rebuttal: argued: The probe edits saffron/gates/suite.py, a file forbidden to me and outside touches, removing the renames=spec.renames keyword from the revert_gate call. This spec's witness, test_cellspecs_renames_comment_names_both_its_readers, is defined in the spec's own Notes for the agent as a pure text match: it reads the comment's source lines and asserts two literal substrings appear. It is not a behavioral check of suite.py's wiring, and the spec explicitly places that kind of check out of scope, citing backlog item b-d2b6b3 as the separate, unbuilt gate for comparing comments against code. The behavior the probe removes is not actually unguarded: the finding itself reports that under this same edit, the pre-existing tests/test_suite.py::test_the_suite_hands_revert_the_specs_own_renames failed, which is the test written for SA-0389 that already covers this wiring. The probe is asking my text-matching witness to also be the comment-vs-code gate this spec explicitly declines to build. I made no change.
